AI Notes.value: Consumer software studio founded 2019 in LA by Benji Taylor, fully remote/distributed; built Honk (messaging) and Family (self-custody crypto wallet). Backed by notable angels (Naval Ravikant, Biz Stone, Ryan Hoover). CONFIRMED DEFUNCT as independent studio: acquired by Avara (Aave Companies) Nov 16, 2023; Benji Taylor himself posted on X: "Los Feliz Engineering, 2019-2023". Taylor moved on to Aave CPO, then Base, then X (hired as design lead for X Money, March 2026). Family wallet abandoned by Aave in Feb 2026. lfe.org still live but the studio is not operating independently. Work is consumer iOS apps + web3 product, not dev-for-hire. Work Status set as Studio (reflecting entity type); functionally dormant since Nov 2023 per founder confirmation. Instagram: no account found after searching handle variants and social directories; LFE has no confirmed Instagram presence. LinkedIn confirmed at /company/los-feliz-engineering. Autonomy 5 as a fully self-directed product studio (while active).
